# fixwire

> A modern, fully-typed FIX protocol engine for TypeScript. Zero runtime
> dependencies, a correct session layer (resend, gap-fill, sequence-reset,
> reconnect), both initiator and acceptor, FIX 4.2 / 4.4 / 5.0 (FIXT.1.1).
> Published on npm as `fixwire`. ESM only, Node 20+.

fixwire handles the FIX session layer; you handle application messages through
events and `[tag, value]` field arrays (or the provided builders). It is
interop-verified against quickfixgo (Go), QuickFIX (C++), and QuickFIX/J (Java).

## Install

`npm install fixwire` — ESM only, use `import`, not `require`.

## Initiator (client)

```ts
import { Session, MsgType, Tag, newOrderSingle, Side, OrdType } from 'fixwire';

const session = new Session({
  senderCompId: 'CLIENT',
  targetCompId: 'VENUE',
  host: 'fix.venue.com',
  port: 9876,
  tls: true, // or { ca, cert, key, servername }
  resetOnLogon: true,
  reconnect: true,
});

session.on('logon', () => {
  session.send(
    MsgType.NewOrderSingle,
    newOrderSingle({
      clOrdId: 'o-1',
      symbol: 'BTC/USD',
      side: Side.Buy,
      orderQty: 1,
      ordType: OrdType.Limit,
      price: 65000,
    }),
  );
});

session.on('app', (msg) => {
  if (msg.msgType === MsgType.ExecutionReport) {
    console.log(msg.get(Tag.ClOrdID), msg.get(Tag.OrdStatus));
  }
});

session.connect();
```

## Acceptor (server)

```ts
import { Acceptor, MsgType, Tag } from 'fixwire';

const acceptor = new Acceptor({ senderCompId: 'SERVER', targetCompId: 'CLIENT', port: 9876 });
acceptor.on('session', (session) => {
  session.on('app', (msg) => {
    if (msg.msgType === MsgType.NewOrderSingle) {
      session.send(MsgType.ExecutionReport, [
        [Tag.ClOrdID, msg.get(Tag.ClOrdID) ?? ''],
        [Tag.ExecType, '0'],
        [Tag.OrdStatus, '0'],
      ]);
    }
  });
});
acceptor.listen();
// Omit `targetCompId` to accept any initiator (multi-counterparty) and learn its
// CompID from the Logon. Add `authenticate: (logon) => boolean` to gate connections.
```

## Events (all typed)

`connect`, `logon`, `app` (in-sequence application message), `message` (every
inbound), `sent` (wire string), `reject`, `reconnecting`, `logout`, `close`,
`error`.

## Key APIs

- `new Session(config)` — initiator. Config: `senderCompId`, `targetCompId`, `host`,
  `port`, `tls?`, `beginString?` (default `FIX.4.4`; use `FIXT.1.1` for 5.x with
  `defaultApplVerId`), `heartBtInt?`, `resetOnLogon?`, `reconnect?`, `store?`,
  `messageStore?`, `username?` / `password?` / `rawData?`, `dictionary?` +
  `validateRequired?`. Methods: `connect()`, `send(msgType, fields)`, `logout()`,
  `disconnect()`, `status`.
- `new Acceptor(config)` — server. Like Session, plus `authenticate?(logon) => boolean`;
  omit `targetCompId` to accept any. Emits `listening` and `session` (per connection).
- `FixMessage` — `msg.get(tag)`, `msg.getInt(tag)`, `msg.msgType`, `msg.seqNum`, `msg.fields`.
- Codec — `encode(fields, beginString?)`, `parse(raw)`, `checksum`, `isChecksumValid`,
  `FixParser` (streaming).
- Dictionary — `parseDictionary(xml)` returns `{ byTag, byName, messages, groups, required }`;
  `describe(msg, dict)` for readable logs; `getGroups(msg, countTag, dict)` extracts
  repeating-group entries; `group(countTag, entries)` builds them outbound.
- Stores — `MemoryStore` / `FileStore` (sequence numbers); `MemoryMessageStore` /
  `FileMessageStore` (resend/replay).
- Builders & constants — `newOrderSingle`, `Side`, `OrdType`, `TimeInForce`, `ApplVerID`,
  `Tag`, `MsgType`, `SOH`.

## Gotchas

- ESM only: `import`, not `require`.
- Fields are `[number, string]` tuples. `send(msgType, fields)` fields EXCLUDE the
  header (8/9/35/34/49/56/52) and trailer (10); the Session adds and sequences them.
- NewOrderSingle usually needs `TransactTime` (60); FIX 4.2 also requires `HandlInst` (21).
- FIX 5.0: set `beginString: 'FIXT.1.1'` and `defaultApplVerId` (e.g. `'9'` for 5.0 SP2).
- `resetOnLogon: true` resets sequence numbers at the start of each session.
